events.headline: October CPI report (released Nov 10, 2026) came in hotter than expected: headline +0.4% m/m vs +0.3% consensus, core +0.3% vs +0.2% consensus, the third straight month of 0.3% core gains; this raised odds of a Fed rate hike at the Dec 9 FOMC meeting, with Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan saying she sees a need for two more quarter-point increases

Nvidia's board of directors opened an independent investigation (announced Nov 8) into CEO Jensen Huang after reports he had a personal relationship with an executive at cloud company Megaspeed alleged by US intelligence to be passing information to Beijing; NVDA fell ~4.3% on Nov 9, erasing nearly $200B in market value, and three House committee chairs asked Huang to respond by Nov 11 ahead of Nvidia's Nov 17 earnings

Oil prices eased to a nearly four-week low amid Iran/Middle East peace talks easing the geopolitical risk premium; Brent traded near $98/bbl on Nov 9 while JPMorgan warned the global oil market is heading toward a supply surplus as Middle East exports recover and non-OPEC production rises
